title: Low Mach Number Limit and Convergence Rates for a Compressible Two-Fluid Model with Algebraic Pressure Closure
summary: We study the low Mach number limit for a viscous compressible two-fluid model with algebraic pressure closure in the three-dimensional torus $\mathbb{T}^3$. The pressure is determined implicitly through the densities of the two phases, which makes the singular limit substantially more delicate than for models with explicit pressure laws.
